::: notes
The product $\mX\vb$ collects all the linear predictors
$\tp{\vx_i}\vb$ into a single $n \times 1$ vector:

$$
\mX\vb =
\begin{bmatrix}
\tp{\vx_1}\vb \\
\vdots \\
\tp{\vx_n}\vb
\end{bmatrix}
$$

The matrix $\tp{\mX}\mX$ is a $p \times p$ symmetric matrix
that appears in the OLS estimator $\hat{\vb} = (\tp{\mX}\mX)^{-1}\tp{\mX}\vy$.
:::
